name: agentguard-mcp
title: AgentGuard MCP Control Plane
description: Active control plane & governance infrastructure for AI agents — infinite loop prevention, circuit breakers, prompt injection protection, and multi-tenant observability.

tools.name: log_checkpoint
tools.description: Record agent tool call checkpoint and evaluate trajectory for infinite loops, parameter repetitions, and runaway execution.

tools.name: validate_tool_response
tools.description: Validate and sanitize tool output against schema expectations and check for prompt injection signatures.

tools.name: detect_anomaly
tools.description: Run statistical Z-score and sliding window EMA anomaly detection on execution latency and response sizes.

tools.name: circuit_breaker_check
tools.description: Query or evaluate target tool Circuit Breaker status (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) to prevent cascading failures.

tools.name: get_session_history
tools.description: Retrieve full execution trajectory, checkpoints, and telemetry for an active agent session.
